Ord Irrigation Cooperative (OIC), an organisation that is owned by the East Kimberley farmers, supply water to crop and livestock production areas in the East Kimberley. We are seeking hard-working Agricultural and Mobile Plant Operators to perform various machinery operation tasks.

DUTIES:
•	Report daily to management of OIC.

•	Operate tractors and implements to slash weeds.

•	Class MR drivers licence.
•	General trade and maintenance skills.
•	Be an Australian citizen or permanent resident. Do not apply if you are a temporary visa holder.


DESIRABLE:
•	ChemCert licence or willing to obtain.

-Agricultural and Horticultural Plant Operators predominantly work in Kununurra however are expected to service locations around OIC’s infrastructure across the Ord River Valley. The climate is extreme, often exceeding 40 degrees Celcius with high humidity. Applicants must be fit to work in these conditions.
-Drug and alcohol testing may be conducted by OIC with zero tolerance for intoxication at any time.
-Only candidates with a genuine commitment to full time employment should apply.


HOW TO APPLY:
Do not apply on this website. Send an email to applications.arafutura @gmail.com (no space) with the subject line ‘OIC Plant Operator application’. - Lead world-class brain MRI research improving child health outcomes
- Develop AI-driven neuroimaging tools for clinical translation
- Collaborate with leading researchers and clinicians globally
 

Advance neonatal brain imaging research using AI and MRI to improve outcomes for babies and children!


The opportunity:


As part of the Developmental Imaging Group, you'll lead the analysis of large neuroimaging datasets from studies involving preterm infants, fetal growth restriction and congenital heart disease.

 

You'll also contribute to the development of the Neonatal Automated Neuro-Anatomist (NANA), an innovative automated infant brain analysis platform designed to support future clinical practice. Working with dedicated high-performance computing resources, you'll collaborate with clinicians, engineers and researchers to develop advanced image analysis methods and publish impactful research.


What you’ll do

 

Lead the analysis and quality assurance of large-scale paediatric MRI datasets
Develop advanced neuroimaging analysis methods and image processing pipelines
Contribute to AI-enabled brain imaging tools for clinical translation
Publish high-quality research and present findings at national and international conferences
Contribute to competitive grant applications and ethics submissions
Collaborate with multidisciplinary research teams and clinical partners
Support students and contribute to a collaborative research culture
 

What you’ll bring

 

A PhD in Medical Imaging, Neuroscience, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline
Experience in high-throughput neuroimaging analysis
Experience working with clinical MRI datasets, including structural and/or diffusion MRI
Strong programming skills in Python and experience with deep learning or machine learning techniques
Experience using neuroimaging analysis software and automated image processing pipelines

Please view the position description here.

Any questions? Reach out to Deanne Thompson on deanne.thompson@mcri.edu.au.


What you’ll enjoy

 

Work on internationally recognised neuroimaging research projects
Access dedicated high-performance computing resources
Collaborate with leading clinicians, engineers and researchers
Access a range of salary packaging options—covering entertainment, novated leases, and more
Enjoy a variety of flexible work arrangements
Take advantage of generous personal leave and the option to purchase additional leave to suit your lifestyle
Perk up with discounted coffee from Synapse, our vibrant onsite café
Enjoy discounted staff parking, public transport right at your doorstep, and great facilities for cyclists
 

Who we are


Murdoch Children’s Research Institute envisions a transformative future for child health. Our institute is a hub of impactful scientific breakthroughs, particularly in early interventions, enhanced diagnosis, prevention, and potential cures. We thrive on collaborative, multidisciplinary problem-solving to address challenging queries in child health. Committed to inclusivity and respect, we foster a positive working environment that values diverse backgrounds and experiences. As a proud member of the Australian Network on Disability and a dedicated supporter of Science Australia Gender Equity (SAGE), we uphold principles of equal opportunity and diverse representation.


We are committed to the safety of children and young people and takes a zero-tolerance approach to all forms of child abuse, exploitation and harm. Child safety is prioritised in our decision-making at all levels of the Institute.   

 

Apply now!


If you believe this role is a good fit for you, please apply by submitting:

 

Your resume
A cover letter addressing the selection criteria

Ensure these documents are combined into a single PDF file.


We welcome individuals of diverse genders, ages, ethnicities, cultural backgrounds, abilities, religions, and sexual orientations in our workplace. - Join ORH Truck Solutions Pty Ltd

ORH Truck Solutions Pty Ltd is a leading manufacturer of innovative and reliable mining vehicles and equipment within Western Australia.

We are currently looking to fill multiple positions in our team, including:
- Automotive Electrician
- Heavy Duty Diesel Mechanic
- Automotive Spray Painter
- Fabricator
- Welder
- Fitter
- Motor Mechanic (General)
- Supply & Distribution Manager

To be successful in these positions, applicants must hold a relevant qualification and have at least 2 years' experience in a similar role.

The Automotive Electrician role will provide expert advice, repairs, installation and maintenance across a range of systems and a range of vehicles in a timely and efficient manner to assist in achieving the goals of the customer.

The role of the Heavy-Duty Diesel Mechanic is to assist in the final stage of production being fit up. Also, to oversee, educate and assist our two 3rd year apprentices in all aspects of servicing, repair and fit up work. Maintaining accurate records of maintenance work completed, repairs as required, fault diagnosis and problem solving.

The Automotive Spray Painter role will provide a level of high-quality painting to a range of vehicles, this includes full preparation of the vehicle to ensure the final product is of the highest standard. All work needs to be completed in a timely and efficient manner to assist in achieving the goals of the customer.

The role of the Fabricator is to create and assemble tanks etc that will be used in the manufacture of various large bodied vehicles. The fabricator ensures that all parts fit perfectly with each other and conform to the specialized sizes and thicknesses as required.

The role of the Welder is to assist the Fabricators where required. Working in a safe and timely manner at all times.

The Fitter is responsible for assembling and fitting metal components and subassemblies to build machinery and related equipment.

The Motor Mechanic (General) role is responsible for testing and repairing engines and motor vehicles.

The role of the Supply & Distribution Manager is to organise and monitor the supply, storage and distribution of goods used and required for the business.

Remuneration between $78,000 - $80,000 will be offered to the successful candidates for these roles.

result.description:
On behalf of our client, we are looking for a Medical Practitioner.  

The role will be responsible for providing patient centred care that addresses health needs and promotes wellness, based on the latest evidence and medical guidelines including conducting examinations and questioning patients to determine the nature of disorders and illnesses, and recording patients' medical information. Where necessary, ordering laboratory tests, X-rays and other diagnostic procedures. Interpreting findings to assist in diagnosis, providing overall care for patients, and prescribing and administering treatments, medications, and other remedial measures. Monitoring patients' progress and response to treatment, advising on diet, exercise and other habits which aid prevention and treatment of disease and disorders, arranging the admission of patients to hospitals as necessary.

The daily duties and responsibilities include:
• Use appropriate equipment like stethoscopes, and blood pressure monitors in therapy and diagnosis.
• Assess if patients need investigations, special care, and treatment.
• Prescribe medicines and carry out surgical procedures.
• Examine and discuss with patients in order to diagnose their health conditions.
• Take a complete history and make detailed notes as a legal documentation of treatment.
• Carry out procedures within the confines of knowledge and general practice
• Work with other doctors and practice staff and allied health personnel as a team member.
• Liaise with other medical and non-medical professionals to guarantee high quality treatment.
• Work in a manner that is compliant with health and safety practices, with particular regard to the handling and disposal of body fluids and sharps.
• Participate in ongoing training offered by the practice, health care services and other related institutions.
• Keep informed of the latest medical information.
• Promote proper health education.
• Participate in creating, presenting, and monitoring health programs or events as appropriate.

Education – Bachelor degree or higher qualification desirable. Industry experience may substitute.

Experience & Skills 
• Must be eligible for registration with AHPRA, RACGP
• Must have positive attitude towards Education, be self-motivated & committed to professional development. Prevocational registered with a view to complete The College Fellowship exams to obtain Vocational Registration within a designated time period.
• Able to respond to demanding and complicated patient situations.
• Effective communication with other doctors as well as patients.
• Maintain concise, timely and accurate confidential records of patients.
• Able to prioritize patients according to their clinical needs.
• Good time management skills to balance clinical and administrative duties.
• Able to solve difficult problems.
• Should be able to challenge decisions if required.
• Strong decision-making and practical skills.
